exposure: Conservative management of placenta accreta spectrum disorders
cohort: Patients with clinically and/or histopathologically confirmed PAS disorders who underwent conservative management by leaving the placenta in situ between 1 January 2013 and 31 December 2021 at Kwong Wah Hospital, Hong Kong
finding: Planned conservative management for placenta accreta spectrum disorders can achieve good clinical outcomes in a regional hospital with a multidisciplinary team.
